text_block_list.text: Thanks, Oguri.

I was so happy! I was on the verge of
tears!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: (Am I... dreaming? This feels so nice...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I catch sight of
Oguri Cap,
Tamamo Cross, and Inari One
having some kind
of dispute.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, Inari. I'll carry your trays. Pile up
as much
food as you like.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm tellin' ya, you don't have to go doin'
stuff like
that for us. We're more than
capable of carryin'
our own trays.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We might be smaller than you, but
we're
not weaklings, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nothin'. Oguri just had herself some
weird
dream is all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...So then everybody thanked me, and I
woke up
feeling all warm and happy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What the?! That's gotta be some kinda
divine
revelation tellin' ya to go out and
start earnin'
people's gratitude... Hah!
Yeah, right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A divine revelation? ...Huh, so that's
what it was!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama, let me carry your stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with ya all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The track looks pretty rough today. Hop
on my
back, Inari. I'll carry you if you'd
like.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Like hell ya will! That totally defeats the
purpose
of me comin' out here to train!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to wipe the blackboard,
Tama?
Here, I'll lift you up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yayyy, upsies, upsies! ...NOT! Cut dat
out! I can
reach the board myself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, she's been like this all day.
Guess I was
a little outta line too, teasin'
her about how that
dream's a divine
revelation 'n' stuff.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The two of us can handle ourselves just
fine.
You'd be better off directin' all that
helpfulness
at someone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But... I want to help the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What kinda anythin'?
choice_data_list: せっかくだし、何かしてもらったら？
choice_data_list_en: Since you have the chance, why not have them do something for you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri and Inari
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: おかずを1個分けてもらうとか……？
choice_data_list_en: Maybe ask them to share one of their side dishes...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what're ya talkin' about?
Listen,
Oguri! That was just a hypothetical

example!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I never even considered that. I suppose I
could
give away some... B-but today the
cafeteria's
serving... fried chicken...
Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Outta da question! The notion of takin'
Oguri's
food just don't sit right with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was only an offhand suggestion, but it
seems
like I've accidentally broached a
taboo topic.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't go fussin' over us! It's the thought
that
counts, so don't force yourself to do
stuff ya
don't wanna do!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, Tama, don't stop me! This is my
moment to
prove how serious I really am
about being helpful!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If it's for the two of you... I can handle it.
I want
you to have this chicken—it's from
the heart!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo and Inari
text_block_list.text: O-Oguriii!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the chicken... This is a real
shocker,
y'know. I can't believe you
actually split your
food with us.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That said... that fried chicken was hella
tasty!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Aw, man. ...Ya got me blubberin' here. Geez, like I needed remindin' how thoughtful ya are... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... Inari... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three gaze tearfully at one another,
all
overcome with emotion. While
basking in their
heartfelt camaraderie...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I start to feel guilty for the part I played
in it all,
and end up sharing my own food
with Oguri Cap.
